How TTMS powers Driver Monitoring

Monitor driver activity, duty readiness, and exception risk without adding friction. Help supervisors coach effectively while keeping daily operations humane and safe. This service emphasizes driver scorecards combining safety, compliance, and service indicators.

  • Driver scorecards combining safety, compliance, and service indicators
  • Shift-level readiness status for dispatch-safe assignment decisions
  • Behavior trend tracking with configurable alert thresholds
  • Coaching workflow with manager notes and follow-up tasks
  • Driver acknowledgment trail for policy and training completion
  • Performance insights by driver, team, and operating region

Driver Safety & Care

Supervisors can intervene earlier with constructive support. Clear expectations reduce misunderstanding and disciplinary friction.

  • Supervisors can intervene earlier with constructive support
  • Clear expectations reduce misunderstanding and disciplinary friction
  • Fatigue and risk signals are visible before incidents escalate
  • Drivers feel supported through transparent coaching frameworks

Driver Monitoring Audit & Compliance Reporting

Driver Monitoring data feeds TTMS reporting automatically so teams can plan monitoring rules aligned to policy and operational realities and maintain audit-ready records.

  • Driver Monitoring events are captured with timestamps and operational context for cleaner audit trails.
  • ELD, AI DashCam, and GPS records support compliance reporting without fragmented manual collection.
  • Owners can review KPI, exception, and safety logs in one TTMS - Total Transport Management System workflow.
  • Teams generate regulator-ready and customer-facing reports with accurate, centralized data.
